persons.name: Yogarāja
persons.evidence: vipraḥ śrīyogarājo vilikhayati mudā svasya pāṭhārtham eva

date.as_written: yāte naipālikābde gagaṇa(!)vasuhaye mādhave māsi śukle, pakṣe śīr devatāyā(!) tithibhṛgutanayā,hargate hasta-ṛkṣe [...] samvat 780 vaiśākhaśudi 13

notes: Chronogram: gagaṇa (0), vasu (8), haya (7) = NS 780. Copied by the brāhmaṇa Yogarāja for his own reading and collected (saṃcaya yāṅā) for the pleasure of Goddess Śāradā.
